import sys

class TaskG:
    cs = [0] * (1 << 21)
    sn = [0] * (1 << 21)
    csi = [0] * (1 << 21)
    sni = [0] * (1 << 21)

    def __init__(self):
        for i in range(len(self.cs)):
            self.cs[i] = (2 * 3.14159265358979323846 * i / len(self.cs)) * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else -1)
            self.sn[i] = (2 * 3.14159265358979323846 * i / len(self.cs)) * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else -1)
            self.csi[i] = (2 * 3.14159265358979323846 * i / len(self.cs)) * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else -1)
            self.sni[i] = (2 * 3.14159265358979323846 * i / len(self.cs)) * (1 if i % 2 == 0 else -1)

    def solve(self, testNumber, inReader, out):
        mod = 998244353
        n = inReader.nextInt()
        k = inReader.nextInt()
        v = [0] * 10
        for i in range(k):
            x = inReader.nextInt()
            v[x] = 1
        ans = [1]
        p = n // 2
        while True:
            if p % 2 != 0:
                ans = self.multiplyMod(ans, v, mod)
            p //= 2
            if p == 0:
                break
            v = self.multiplyMod(v, v, mod)
        res = 0
        for x in ans:
            res = (res + (x * x) % mod) % mod
        out.write(str(res) + "\n")
        out.flush()

    def multiplyMod(self, a, b, mod):
        need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
        n = max(2, (need - 1).bit_length() << 1)

        aReal = [0] * n
        aImaginary = [0] * n
        for i in range(len(a)):
            x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod
            aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            aImaginary[i] = x >> 15
        self.fft(aReal, aImaginary, False)

        bReal = [0] * n
        bImaginary = [0] * n
        for i in range(len(b)):
            x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            bImaginary[i] = x >> 15
        self.fft(bReal, bImaginary, False)

        faReal = [0] * n
        faImaginary = [0] * n
        fbReal = [0] * n
        fbImaginary = [0] * n

        for i in range(n):
            j = (n - i) & (n - 1)

            wA = self.csi[i] if i % 2 == 0 else self.sni[i]
            wB = self.sn[i] if i % 2 == 0 else self.csi[i]
            uA = aReal[i]
            uB = aImaginary[i]
            vA = aReal[j] * wA - aImaginary[j] * wB
            vB = aReal[j] * wB + aImaginary[j] * wA
            aReal[i] = uA + vA
            aImaginary[i] = uB + vB
            aReal[j] = uA - vA
            aImaginary[j] = uB - vB

            wA = self.csi[i] if i % 2 == 0 else self.sni[i]
            wB = self.sn[i] if i % 2 == 0 else self.csi[i]
            uA = bReal[i]
            uB = bImaginary[i]
            vA = bReal[j] * wA - bImaginary[j] * wB
            vB = bReal[j] * wB + bImaginary[j] * wA
            bReal[i] = uA + vA
            bImaginary[i] = uB + vB
            bReal[j] = uA - vA
            bImaginary[j] = uB - vB

        self.fft(faReal, faImaginary, True)
        self.fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, True)
        res = [0] * need
        for i in range(need):
            aa = (faReal[i] + 0.5)
            bb = (fbReal[i] + 0.5)
            cc = (faImaginary[i] + 0.5)
            res[i] = (int(((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)))
        return res

    def fft(self, a, b, inverse):
        n = len(a)
        shift = 32 - n.bit_length()
        for i in range(1, n):
            j = (n - i) >> shift
            if i < j:
                a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
                b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]
        for len in (2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536):
            if len > n:
                continue
            halfLen = len >> 1
            for i in range(0, n, len):
                w = len // halfLen
                for j in range(0, halfLen):
                    k = j * w
                    wA = self.csi[k] if inverse else self.cs[k]
                    wB = self.sn[k] if inverse else self.sn[k]
                    uA = a[i + j]
                    uB = b[i + j]
                    vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB
                    vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA
                    a[i + j] = uA + vA
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB
                    a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA
                    b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB
            shift += 1
        if inverse:
            for i in range(n):
                a[i] /= n
                b[i] /= n

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self.stream = stream
        self.buf = bytearray(1024)
        self.pos = 0
        self.size = 0

    def nextInt(self):
        c = self.stream.read(1)
        while c <= 32:
            c = self.stream.read(1)
        sign = 1
        if c == 45:
            sign = -1
            c = self.stream.read(1)
        res = 0
        while c >= 48 and c <= 57:
            res = res * 10 + c - 48
            c = self.stream.read(1)
        while c <= 32:
            c = self.stream.read(1)
        return res * sign

def main():
    input_stream = sys.stdin
    output_stream = sys.stdout
    in_reader = InputReader(input_stream)
    out = output_stream
    task_g = TaskG()
    task_g.solve(1, in_reader, out)
    out.flush()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
